assessment_summary:
0001-0018: Valid setup, assumptions for contradiction, and definitions of cut capacities and the intersection cut.
0019-0020: Valid statement of a mathematically correct submodularity inequality for cut capacities.
0021-0023: Valid observations about the edge's presence in the initial cuts.
0024: Invalid, the edge u->v goes from S \cap T' to T \cap S', so it IS included in the cut capacity c(S \cap T', T \cap S'). The text falsely claims it is not.
0025: Invalid, continuation of flawed claim from 0024.
0026-0030: Invalid, incorrectly derives that the cut capacity is strictly less than 2c(S,T) based on the false claim in 0024.
0031: Valid, correctly states a property of minimum cuts.
0032-0033: Invalid, falsely claims that a cut capacity being less than 2c(S,T) contradicts minimality (a cut capacity only needs to be at least c(S,T), so being less than 2c(S,T) is perfectly valid).
0034-0041: Invalid, repeats the flawed edge counting logic and derivations.
0042-0044: Invalid, repeats the false claim that a capacity < 2c(S,T) contradicts minimality.
0045-0052: Invalid, concludes the proof based on the flawed edge accounting and the false contradiction.
